name: fireprotection_query_catalog_notification_appliances
title: Query notification appliance catalog entries
description: Queries the loaded notification appliance catalog for families, types, and their properties. Returns all notification appliance families, or types for a specific family, or full entries for a family. Use this to populate UI dropdowns or to look up appliance specifications (appliance type, candela rating, dBA rating) before running calculations.

family_name.description: Optional family name to filter by. If omitted, returns all families.

include_entries.description: If true and family_name is provided, returns full entries with all properties.
